name: dealeriq
author: Ahmed Elshazly
description: DealerIQ workspace root (npm workspaces) — see docs/adr/016-js-monorepo-tooling.md

scripts.build:vercel: npm run docs:site && npm run build:web
scripts.docs: npm --prefix docs-app install --silent && npm --prefix docs-app run start
scripts.docs:pack: npm --prefix docs-app install --silent && npm --prefix docs-app run pack
scripts.docs:verify: npm --prefix docs-app install --silent && npm --prefix docs-app run verify
scripts.docs:site: npm --prefix docs-app ci --include=dev --silent && npm --prefix docs-app run site
